findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

The PIC was unable to show that employees were made aware of their responsibility to report potential foodborne illness related symptoms and diagnosis. Education was conducted. The inspector will send a copy of the Reporting Agreement given out by this department in the morning and follow up in 10 days to ensure compliance.

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events.
findings.citation_text:
2-501.11 Clean-up of Vomiting and Diarrheal Events. A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.

During this inspection the PIC was unable to show a Norovirus clean up procedure to the inspection. The inspector gave the PIC a copy of the procedure distributed by this department to correct. Ensure that all needed procedures and paperwork are available at all times.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (1) Filling or closing holes and other gaps along floors, walls, and ceilings; (2) Closed, tight-fitting windows; and (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. 

The receiving door does not appear to completely seal as it should. The PIC was notified and the importance discussed. Repair/replace the door sweep prior to the next routine inspection and maintain it in good repair moving froward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

All observed mops are stored with the bristles pooled up in the mop sink and the mop bucket. Education was conducted and the PIC instructed to review with all employees correct storage procedures. Ensure that all mops are stored between uses so that the bristles hang/drip dry.
